escopo.objetivo: Explicar como o sistema imune reconhece e controla fungos e vírus (inata e adaptativa) e como esses patógenos evadem a resposta.

autoral_excecao: O AnKing cobre interferons, NK, CTL e o CMV, mas não traz o que a aula ensina sobre fungos (parede como PAMP, inflamassoma → Th17/Th1, Th1 e Th17 × Th2 e Treg) nem a organização dos TLRs e do escape viral; busca em seções, palavra-chave e significado não achou esses cards.

fields.Text: Antibodies protect against viruses by {{c1::neutralization}} (Fab) and, through Fc, by {{c2::ADCC}} and {{c3::complement}}
fields.Extra:
- IgA and IgG neutralize the virus before it enters the cell
- Fc also allows opsonization, which matters less for viruses

fields.Text: A CD8 T cell primed by a {{c1::dendritic}} cell must find the peptide on {{c2::MHC I}} of the infected cell
fields.Extra:
- CD4 help and cross-presentation prime the CD8 cell
- Then it releases perforin, granzyme and Fas ligand and survives to kill again

fields.Text: Viruses lower MHC I by blocking the {{c1::proteasome}}, {{c2::TAP}} or MHC I export from the {{c2::ER}}
fields.Extra:
- HSV blocks TAP with ICP47; CMV also lowers MHC I
- Low MHC I protects from CD8 cells but exposes the cell to NK cells

fields.Text: CMV infects white blood cells and blocks expression of {{c1::MHC I}}, inhibiting cytotoxic T-cell killing

fields.Text: Antigenic variation of influenza viruses occurs with changes to viral {{c1::hemagglutinin (HA)}} and {{c1::neuraminidase (NA)}}
fields.Extra:
- This is also how influenza viruses are named

- Antigenic shifts: exchange of RNA segments between humans and animals → radically new HA or NA types → pandemics
- Antigenic drifts: spontaneous mutations → slightly altered HA or NA types → epidemics

entries.sem_imagem: fato ou conjunto sem estrutura a reconhecer; as figuras da aula são esquemas de livro sem equivalente nos acervos

fields.Text: Antigenic variation can be due to antigenic {{c1::drift}} or antigenic {{c2::shift}}
fields.Extra:
- Antigenic shifts: exchange of RNA segments between humans and animals → radically new HA or NA types → pandemics

- Antigenic drifts: spontaneous mutations → slightly altered HA or NA typers → epidemics

entries.alvo: Deriva: mutações pontuais em HA ou NA
entries.extra_add: - Small mutations only partly reduce immunity from earlier infections, which is why the vaccine changes every year
entries.sem_imagem: fato ou conjunto sem estrutura a reconhecer; as figuras da aula são esquemas de livro sem equivalente nos acervos

fields.Text: Antigenic {{c1::drift}} occurs when there are {{c2::point mutations}} in hemagglutinin or neuraminidase
fields.Extra:
- Antigenic drifts: spontaneous mutations → slightly altered HA or NA types → epidemics
- Antigenic shifts: exchange of RNA segments between humans and animals → radically new HA or NA types → pandemics




- Small mutations only partly reduce immunity from earlier infections, which is why the vaccine changes every year

fields.Text: The outcome of an infection is the balance between pathogen {{c1::pathogenicity}} and host immune {{c2::response}}
fields.Extra:
- An exaggerated response can itself damage tissue, as in hepatitis, where the immune response injures hepatocytes
- Pathogens survive by evading the immune response

fields.Text:
Inflammasome:
- signal 1: {{c1::NF-κB}} makes pro-IL-1β
- signal 2: {{c2::ATP}} or K+ efflux assembles it
- {{c3::caspase-1}} makes active IL-1β
fields.Extra:
- IL-1β is made as an inactive precursor and must be cleaved
- The same pathway releases active IL-18

fields.Text: Th1 and Th17 responses protect against fungi, whereas {{c1::Th2}} and {{c2::Treg}} responses make the disease worse
fields.Extra:
- TLR2 signaling favors Treg, which is deleterious in fungal infection
- Exception: in Pneumocystis a Th2 response may protect

fields.Text: Inhibition of {{c1::TNF-α}} (e.g., immunosuppression, drugs) results in lack of granuloma formation and resultant reactivation of tuberculosis
fields.Extra:
- Individuals who are to be started on a TNF-α inhibitor (e.g., infliximab) should receive a PPD test

- Lack of TNF-α = lack of granuloma = lack of containment of tuberculosis
